mapper.select: SELECT task.task_order_id 'taskOrderId', SUM( task.task_quantity )'taskQuantity', SUM( task.complete_quantity ) 'completeQuantity', SUM(( task.task_quantity - task.complete_quantity )* enc.length) 'totalLength' FROM mes_enclosure_task task LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure enc ON task.product_id = enc.id GROUP BY task.task_order_id

SELECT
MONTH( mc.create_time) date,
DAY( mc.create_time) date,
IFNULL( sum( enc.length * mc.quantity ), 0 )/1000 totalLength FROM mes_building_complete mc LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure enc ON mc.product_id = enc.id AND enc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE mc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and mc.task_type_enum=4
AND enc.category = #{category}
AND date_format( mc.create_time, '%Y' ) = date_format( #{dateTime}, '%Y' )
AND date_format( mc.create_time, '%Y%m' ) = date_format( #{dateTime}, '%Y%m' )
GROUP BY date

SELECT
MONTH( mc.create_time) date,
DAY( mc.create_time) date,
IFNULL( sum( enc.length * mc.quantity ), 0 )/1000 totalLength FROM mes_building_complete mc LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure enc ON mc.product_id = enc.id AND enc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE mc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and mc.task_type_enum = 4
AND enc.dictionary_id = #{dictionaryId}
AND date_format( mc.create_time, '%Y' ) = date_format( #{dateTime}, '%Y' )
AND date_format( mc.create_time, '%Y%m' ) = date_format( #{dateTime}, '%Y%m' )
GROUP BY date

SELECT task.id, pro.id 'project.id', pro.`name` 'project.name', pro.short_name 'project.shortName', pro.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', ord.order_number, ord.id 'orderId', fac.id 'factory.id', fac.`name` 'factory.name', shop.id 'workshop.id', shop.`name` 'workshop.name', line.id 'productionLine.id', line.`name` 'productionLine.name', line.type 'line.type', team.id, plan.id 'plan.id', plan.`name` 'plan.name', plan.date 'plan.date', plan.quantity_work 'plan.quantityWork', enc.id 'productId', enc.`name` 'name', enc.length, cess.id 'process.id', cess.NAME 'process.name', task.task_quantity 'taskQuantity', task.complete_quantity 'completeQuantity', task.ask_complete_time 'askCompleteTime', enc.serial_number 'serialNumber', enc.category 'category', enc.plate, enc.color, enc.material, enc.thickness, enc.coating, enc.plating FROM mes_enclosure_task task LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_task_order ord ON ord.id = task.task_order_id LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure enc ON task.product_id = enc.id LEFT JOIN enclosure_plan plan ON enc.enclosure_plan_id = plan.id LEFT JOIN contract_project pro ON enc.project_id = pro.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory fac ON task.factory_id = fac.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop shop ON task.workshop_id = shop.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_production_line line ON task.production_line_id = line.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team team ON task.team_id = team.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process cess ON task.process_id = cess.id WHERE task.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND task.id = #{id}

SELECT task.* FROM mes_enclosure_task task LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_produce_team_report report ON task.product_id = report.product_id AND task.id = report.task_id where task.task_order_id = #{orderId} and task.bool_delete_enum = 0 and report.bool_delete_enum = 0 and report.task_id is not null GROUP BY task.id
